text: Entry-rule backtest on journal minute data (IBKR 1-min, Oct 7-22; Oct 14 mostly missing). 764 stock-days of scanner names with a full regular session and previous close (journal closes, else Finviz daily close scaled to IBKR for splits). Entries 15:30-19:30 SAST at next minute's open, one per rule per stock-day. Rules: A near high = up 15%+ vs prev close and within 6% of the running high (Sarantis's losing-trade pattern); B1 open = buy the open when it gaps 10%+; B2 pullback = after reaching +15%, 10%+ below running high but above VWAP; C = 1-min 9 EMA crosses above regular-session VWAP while up 15%+. Exits: (1) 13% stop else hold to 22:00 close; (2) +10% target or 30 minutes, 13% stop. Gross results (avg / median / win%): A hold 240 trades -0.50/-1.58/43%; A quick +1.46/+1.36/56%. B1 hold 100 -1.55/-7.06/37%; B1 quick +0.83/+2.48/55%. B2 hold 95 -5.48/-13.0/21%; B2 quick -0.08/-0.56/49%. C hold 131 -2.37/-5.67/32%; C quick +0.15/-0.81/46%. By size of move at entry (rule A): up <30% hold +0.29, quick +1.93 (201); up 30-60% hold -1.07, quick +0.13 (26); up 60%+ hold -11.54 (0 of 13 positive), quick -3.16 (13). Rule B1 by gap: <20% quick -0.41 (49); 20-40% quick +5.01, 77% win (30); 40%+ hold -10.22, quick -2.26 (21). Costs at his size about 1% per side (about 2% round trip) are not deducted. Three weeks of data; the gap and move-size buckets were split after seeing results and need to be checked on new weeks.
